user.title: SwissWeather Fusion — Location
user.description: Coordinates only (never a postal code) — precision here matters for the microclimate correction this integration does. Defaults to your Home Assistant home location. Elevation is looked up automatically; enter a value below only if you have a more precise one (e.g. from a differential GPS survey).

station.title: SwissWeather Fusion — Local station
station.description: Select the sensor entities for your local weather station. Rain and wind can be added once your station supports them.

credentials.title: SwissWeather Fusion — API credentials
credentials.description: All four credentials are stored securely and never written to a YAML file. SRF and meteoblue and Meteonomiqs credentials are obtained from their respective developer portals — see the README for links.

reauth_confirm.title: SwissWeather Fusion — Re-authenticate SRF
reauth_confirm.description: Your SRF (SRG SSR) consumer key/secret needs to be updated, e.g. after rotating it on their developer portal.

error.elevation_lookup_failed: Could not automatically look up elevation for these coordinates. Enter one manually, or check your network connection and try again.
